io.github.multi-agent-llm-teams/transpor.summary: This site has no streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint. Its tools are registered client-side via the WebMCP API (document.modelContext.registerTool, https://webmachinelearning.github.io/webmcp/) when an agent loads the page in a WebMCP-capable browser. No authentication is required.
